decision_gate.core_failure_definition: A repetition has a core failure when any zero-based criterion index listed in that case's core_criteria is false in the completed blind review.

efficiency.semantics: Promptfoo recorded totals for this run only; percent = comparison/reference - 1.

analysis.ceiling_effect_note: All arms passed every frozen criterion, so this run cannot estimate relative quality improvement.

decision.conclusion: Keep 0.1.0 unchanged. The six synthetic explicit-planning tasks found no failures and no measurable advantage over baseline or the fixed upstream arm.

limitations: Six synthetic single-turn text-planning tasks, one model, one reasoning effort, and three repetitions per arm.
The reviewer was model-assisted, knew the frozen protocol and skills, and was blind only to the randomized arm mapping.
No implicit routing, image generation, rendered image quality, file writeback, editor integration, or real-reader comprehension was tested.
All three arms reached the ceiling, so the result does not establish relative benefit or a general product ranking.
Raw Promptfoo artifacts remain git-ignored; the public report embeds synthetic outputs and hashes but a fresh clone cannot independently recreate provider events.
